penalty_offline_nodes_desc: {count} eero node(s) are offline or unreachable.
rec_offline_nodes: Check power and connectivity for disconnected nodes ({names}).
penalty_degraded_backhaul_desc: Some mesh extender nodes have weak wireless backhaul or a link limited to 100 Mbps.
rec_degraded_backhaul: For nodes with weak mesh signal, reduce distance to Gateway. For 100 Mbps links, verify Ethernet Cat 5e/6 cable integrity.
issue_wan_offline: Internet connection inactive or gateway offline
penalty_wan_offline_desc: eero network reports loss of Internet access from provider or gateway offline.
rec_wan_offline: Check the cable between your provider modem (ONT/FTTH/DSL) and the eero gateway WAN port.
penalty_high_latency_desc: Average ping recorded from Gateway to external network is high ({ping} ms > 80 ms).
rec_high_latency: If latency remains consistently above 80 ms, run a direct speed test or check provider modem/router congestion.
penalty_moderate_latency_desc: Recorded WAN latency of {ping} ms (above ideal 45 ms threshold).
wan_summary_ok: Gateway online, active public IP ({ip}), optimal latency.
penalty_weak_clients_desc: {count} wireless device(s) have degraded RSSI signal (< -75 dBm), which may cause packet loss or reduced throughput.
rec_weak_clients: Move devices ({devices}) closer to the nearest mesh node or consider repositioning to eliminate dead zones.
client_summary_ok: All {count} wireless devices have excellent RSSI signal (>= -75 dBm).
penalty_band_24_desc: {count} out of {total} wireless clients are connected on 2.4 GHz channels, potentially saturating the spectrum.
rec_band_24: Enable 'Band Steering' in settings to automatically route compatible devices to 5 GHz or 6 GHz.
penalty_node_overload_desc: Node '{node}' handles more than 80% of all connected household devices.
channel_summary_ok: Balanced frequency distribution: 6 GHz ({c6}), 5 GHz ({c5}), 2.4 GHz ({c24}).
rec_all_optimal: All eero mesh stability parameters are optimal. No corrective action needed.
